prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production repeating ground material for ModWorld browser-only 2.5D fantasy RPG. Generate one square 1024x1024 OPAQUE seamless diffuse texture tile viewed EXACTLY STRAIGHT DOWN at 90 degrees, unprojected world space. The runtime applies its oblique camera matrix; do not bake camera tilt, ellipse compression, perspective, horizon, or depth gradient. Style: cohesive restrained hand-painted pixel-cluster fantasy terrain matching small pixel-art characters, crisp material groups, muted natural palette, readable low-to-moderate contrast, medium-scale organic patches rather than fine visual noise. Equal detail and lighting across entire tile, opposite borders join seamlessly, no central composition or directional road. All ground is traversable. NO standing trees, bushes, buildings, cliffs, large rocks, cast shadows, actors, text, UI, symbols, borders, checkerboard or watermark. Subject: open meadow floor with muted sage and olive short grass, sparse tiny clover and straw, irregular patches of warm brown compacted soil and a few flat pebbles. More open and quieter than a forest floor. No flowers as focal points, no tall vegetation. Diffuse neutral daylight.
